$comment: Settings for SharePointGovernance/tools/build_solution.py --root solutions/EnterprisePMO. Bump 'version' for every release you import.
description: Daily executive overdue digest, weekly predictive early warning and RAID / action date churn tracking for the Enterprise PMO hub site.

PMOSiteUrl.description: Full URL of the Enterprise PMO site that holds the PMO lists and the hub page, e.g. https://{tenant}.sharepoint.com/sites/EnterprisePMO. No trailing slash.

PMOOwnerEmail.description: Shared mailbox or distribution list that gets every PMO flow's Flow failed alert and the digest-not-posted email. Never a person's own address.

SupportMailboxEmail.description: Optional second address copied on every failure email (e.g. the IT support or Communications shared mailbox). Empty means no copy.

SteerCoTeamId.description: Teams team (group) ID of the team holding the Executive PMO Steering Committee channel. Flow 01 posts the daily digest there. The flow owner must be a member.

SteerCoChannelId.description: Channel ID (19:...@thread.tacv2) of the Executive PMO Steering Committee channel.

DigestEnabled.description: Master switch for flow 01. No (the default) means it reads nothing and posts nothing. Set to Yes once the channel IDs are set and a test card has been checked.

DigestMaxItems.description: Most overdue items listed in each digest section (oldest first); the card says how many more there are. Keeps the card under the Teams size limit. Default 20.

RiskAdvisoryTeamId.description: Teams team (group) ID of the team holding the PMO Risk Advisory channel. Flow 02 posts early-warning cards there. The flow owner must be a member.

RiskAdvisoryChannelId.description: Channel ID of the PMO Risk Advisory channel.

EarlyWarningEnabled.description: Lets flow 02 post advisory cards to Teams. No (the default) still writes the weekly PMO Trend Snapshots, so thresholds can be tuned on real data before anyone is alerted.

EarlyWarningThreshold.description: Score (0 to 3, one point per indicator) at which flow 02 posts an advisory. Default 2.

RiskVelocityThreshold.description: Net new risks and issues in 7 days (opened minus closed) that scores RVEL-HIGH. Default 2.

BurnDownThresholdPercent.description: Action burn-down ratio below this percentage scores ABD-SLO. Default 75 (ratio 0.75).

BurnDownMinActionsDue.description: ABD-SLO only scores when at least this many open actions are due in the next 10 days. Default 3.

ChurnThreshold.description: Number of times one item's date must be pushed later within the churn window to score CHURN-CRIT. Default 2.

ChurnWindowDays.description: Look-back window for date churn, used by flows 02, 03a and 03b. Default 14.
